prompt.name: Authoritative REU Validation
prompt.description: Research current NSF REU opportunities in AI and machine learning for undergraduates, identify the strongest currently relevant official opportunities, verify deadlines and eligibility from authoritative sources, and produce a concise actionable shortlist with uncertainty clearly labeled where needed.

task.name: Authoritative REU Validation
task.description: Research current NSF REU opportunities in AI and machine learning for undergraduates, identify the strongest currently relevant official opportunities, verify deadlines and eligibility from authoritative sources, and produce a concise actionable shortlist with uncertainty clearly labeled where needed.

research_plan.restated_task: Identify and validate current NSF REU opportunities in AI and machine learning for undergraduates in 2024, producing a concise shortlist with verified deadlines and eligibility criteria, clearly noting any uncertainties.

subtasks.description: Identify and collect all publicly available NSF REU opportunities related to AI and machine learning for undergraduates in 2024. Focus on official program listings, not just research papers.
subtasks.success_criteria: A list of all identified REU programs, including the program name, institution, and URL. This should include both direct NSF REU listings and links to program websites.

subtasks.description: For each identified REU opportunity, gather information on eligibility criteria (e.g., major requirements, GPA minimums, citizenship).
subtasks.success_criteria: A table summarizing the eligibility criteria for each identified REU program. Data should be sourced directly from the program website or NSF documentation.

subtasks.description: Broaden lead discovery across multiple authoritative program sources instead of focusing on a single incidental page.
subtasks.success_criteria: Identify multiple distinct opportunities or program leads from official program pages, .gov, .edu, or primary organization sources, and note which leads warrant deeper verification.

subtasks.description: Assess the relevance of each identified REU opportunity to the core task of AI and machine learning for undergraduates, considering the research focus of the program.
subtasks.success_criteria: A classification of each REU opportunity as ‘Highly Relevant’, ‘Relevant’, or ‘Not Relevant’ based on its alignment with the task’s scope. Justification for each classification should be briefly documented.
